references.text: When you build a new house, you shall make a parapet around your roof, so that you do not bring bloodguilt on your house if anyone falls from it.

Jesus teaches about worries and emphasizes the importance of putting God's kingdom first before material concerns, which can be seen as related to not going down into the house to get things in a crisis situation.
On that day, let the one who is on the housetop, with his goods in the house, not come down to take them out, and let the one who is in the field not turn back.
